messages:
Sam: quick one — noticed a weird quota graph bleed in /insights for customers. rapid org-switch shows a ~30s spike from the previous org's token usage on the new org's dashboard. attaching screenshot + tiny logs. https://img.redwood.example/shot.png

Natalie: repro steps? I can try locally

Sam: repro: login as test user, open insights -> quota, switch org from A -> B quickly (use quick-switch). Graph will show A's spike overlayed on B for a short window.

Kevin: hmm. do we have any prefix caching on the route that could mix org headers?

Sam: looking at request traces, saw router header munging around the prefetch stage. log snippet: ```INFO request=rx123 route=/api/insights/usage user=alice cookie-org=org-A x-org-header=org-B router-prefetch-key="user:alice"```

Maria: that log looks like we key prefetch by user+route instead of by org+route. then cache gets reused across orgs for the same user. :facepalm:

Natalie: confirmed locally — router.prefetch.key currently set to `user_id:route` in code. quick diff: `- key = f"{user_id}:{route}"
+ key = f"{org_id}:{user_id}:{route}"`

Kevin: nice find. two followups: 1) quantify how much telemetry misattr happened (billing/alerts), 2) check if telemetry aggregator batches by sample key causing delayed attribution.

Sam: preliminary numbers: found ~120 events misattributed across 3 customers in the last hour (canary window). billing impact tiny but UX alarming.

Maria: also see related issue where quota SLO alerts fired in org B because rate limiter reads the cached metric. could be noisy for support.

Natalie: will open a quick PR to change prefetch key to include org + add a unit test for rapid org switch. also add an integration test to simulate quick-switch and assert no cross-org leakage in cache hits.

Kevin: sounds good. guardrails: if we change key, we should invalidate existing prefetch caches on the canary nodes to avoid stale collisions.

Sam: deploy plan: patch + canary -> monitor quota graph + support queue for 30m -> if OK, rollout. we should also patch the telemetry aggregator to tag events with the canonical org_id from request headers before batching.

Maria: can we also add an alert that triggers if an org's dashboard suddenly sees >20% of traffic attributed to a different org_id in sliding window? would catch regressions faster.

Natalie: will include the alert in the PR (prom rule + grafana panel) and a short playbook entry.

Sam: assigning: @Natalie to PR + tests, @Kevin to invalidate canary caches script, @Maria to draft alert rule, I'll own monitoring and rollback. ETA for PR: ~2h.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for patch/router-prefetch-key scheduled (nodes: canary-3, canary-4). Watchers: Sam, Natalie, Kevin, Maria.

Kevin: quick note — also double-check quota middleware where we materialize usage counters; it sometimes reads `prefetch_cache.get()` without passing org context. I'll audit and send followup.

Sam: great — if anyone hits issues ping #oncall. thanks all. :thumbsup:
